steps.what: Alter or modify designs to obtain specified performance
Check functional or operational performance on the vehicle

tasks.design: The engineer alters or modifies designs to obtain specified functional or operational performance. {DOCS} only opens the stored target. A missing target stays blank. Changing the design and checking the vehicle stay at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The engineer looked up the target and changed the design, then checked the vehicle.
tasks.enabler_now: A design identifier can open a target already written.
tasks.still_hard: Changing the design and checking the vehicle stay with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer does not change a design when the target is blank.
tasks.altitude: The modification stays the engineer's. Only finding the target is shorter.

evidence.claim: A stored design identifier can open a performance target. Altering the design and checking the vehicle stay manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a design that misses its target and ends when the engineer has modified it and checked the vehicle, or stops.
A target row has design identifier and the specified value, entered by the engineer or the vehicle lead. A missing value is left blank.
Opening the target does not shorten the design change or the vehicle check.
unknowns: Who may change a target after the design is released.
research_questions: How often was the target blank, so the engineer stopped?

already_counted.description: Altering the design to obtain the specified performance is already in the engineer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: opening the target adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the target is often blank, so the modification is unchanged. High: the target opens, and altering the design plus the vehicle check remain. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research and implement green vehicle technologies

steps.what: Research green automotive technologies involving alternative fuels
Implement lighter and more efficient electric or hybrid vehicles

tasks.design: The engineer researches or implements green automotive technologies involving alternative fuels, electric or hybrid vehicles, or lighter or more efficient vehicles. Nothing is generated in {DOCS}. The research and the implementation stay at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The engineer studies the technology and implements it on the vehicle.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing and implementing the technology stay with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer does not implement a technology the research does not support.
tasks.altitude: The research and the implementation stay with the engineer. Nothing in them is shortened.

reach.task: Choose which green technology to pursue
reach.learn: Which fuels the lead has ruled out.

evidence.claim: Researching or implementing these green automotive technologies stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a technology question and ends when the engineer has researched or implemented it, or stops.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
A production release of the vehicle is a different task.
unknowns: Which green technologies are in scope for this vehicle.
research_questions: Which technologies did the engineer stop because the research did not support them?

already_counted.description: Researching green automotive technologies is already in the engineer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the research adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every technology is still judged by the engineer. High: the same research and implementation remain, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.design: The engineer develops calibration methodologies, test methodologies, or tools. Nothing is generated in {DOCS}. Developing the method stays at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The engineer designs the method and the tool.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing how to calibrate or test stays with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer rejects a method that cannot show the measurement.
tasks.altitude: The methodology stays the engineer's. Nothing in it is shortened.

reach.task: Try the method on the rig
reach.learn: Which steps the technician could not run.

evidence.claim: Developing calibration methodologies, test methodologies, or tools stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a measurement that needs a method and ends when the engineer has developed it, or stops.
No new record is filed by a system. Upkeep is zero.
Using the method on a vehicle is a different task.
unknowns: Which measurements still have no agreed method.
research_questions: Which methods did the engineer reject on the rig?

already_counted.description: Developing calibration methodologies is already in the engineer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: developing the method adds no separate record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every method is still developed by the engineer. High: the same development remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Create design alternatives for vehicle components
Consider alternative conditioning systems to increase efficiency

tasks.design: The engineer creates design alternatives for vehicle components, such as camless or dual-clutch engines or alternative conditioning systems, to increase efficiency. Nothing is generated in {DOCS}. Creating the alternatives stays at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The engineer sketches the alternatives and judges efficiency.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the alternative stays with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer drops an alternative that does not increase efficiency.
tasks.altitude: The alternatives stay the engineer's work. Nothing in it is shortened.

reach.task: Choose which alternative to take forward

evidence.claim: Creating these design alternatives stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a component and ends when the engineer has created an alternative or stopped.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
A released drawing of the chosen alternative is a different task.
unknowns: Which components are open to an alternative.
research_questions: Which alternatives did the engineer drop because efficiency did not increase?

already_counted.description: Creating design alternatives for vehicle components is already in the engineer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the alternatives add no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every alternative is still created by the engineer. High: the same design work remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

role.altitude: The engineer still tests, calibrates, and signs the design. A report, estimate, procedure, or document is written or published only after the engineer accepts that version.
reach: A project lead receives only a status report the engineer has accepted.
A production colleague receives only a procedure the engineer has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required figure, milestone, or price is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a publication.
Keep testing, calibration, and design decisions in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every status report traces to a stored milestone, and the engineer still signs the exception.
